# Spec: native client parity, increment 1 (GitHub Copilot)

**Generated by:** /li-plan on 2026-09-28
**Status:** APPROVED (2026-09-28; operator direction plus the plan review in review.md: Stage 1 GREEN, Stage 2 YELLOW resolved)
**Design doc:** [design.md](design.md)
**Plan:** [plan.md](plan.md)
**Decision:** [ADR-0039](../../decisions/0039-native-client-artifacts.md)

## Architecture overview

`bin/li-copilot.py` remains the single generator. It is also the Universal entry point through
`bin/li-adapter.py`. A declarative `NATIVE_HOSTS` profile drives native rendering: increment 1
implements `copilot`, and increment 2 adds `codex`, `cursor` and `claude`.

Generated outputs are committed and drift-checked by `li-copilot check`, which CI runs through
`.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The canonical sources stay unchanged and authoritative:
`skills/*/SKILL.md`, `agents/<category>/*.md`, `hooks/shared/*/run.sh` and `hooks/hooks.json`.

```text
canonical skills/agents ──► li-copilot generate() ──► .github/skills/li-*/SKILL.md (all 96, full body)
                                                  └─► .github/agents/*.agent.md (69 canonical + 3 roles)
hooks/hooks.json ──► registration mapping ──► .github/plugin/hooks.json (local/plugin, always)
                                         └─► .github/hooks/lintel.json (kit, only with --hooks)
Copilot host ──stdin JSON──► hooks/adapters/copilot.sh ──► hooks/shared/<name>/run.sh (unchanged)
             ◄──one JSON object (+progress lines), exit 0──┘
```

## Data model, interfaces and contracts

### Native host profile (Copilot)

```python
NATIVE_HOSTS = {
    "copilot": {
        "skill_root": ".github/skills", "skill_name": "li-{name}",
        "agent_root": ".github/agents", "agent_file": "{name}.agent.md",
        "invocation": "/li-{name}",
        "tool_rewrites": {"AskUserQuestion": "ask_user"},
        "skill_frontmatter": ("name", "description"),
        "agent_frontmatter": ("name", "description", "tools"),
        "agent_body_limit": 30000, "description_limit": 1024,
    },
}
```

### Skill preamble (exact text; `{root}` is `../../..` locally or `../../lintel` vendored; `{canonical}` is the canonical path)

```markdown
> **Lintel on GitHub Copilot.** Generated from `{canonical}`; edit the canonical file, then run
> `li-copilot init`.
> - **Resource root:** `{root}` from this skill's base directory (the Lintel source with `bin/`,
>   `lib/`, `skills/`). Write plans, state and evidence into the working repository's `.claude/`
>   tree, never into the resource root.
> - **Shell steps:** run Bash snippets with Bash (Git for Windows' `bash.exe` on Windows, never
>   `System32\bash.exe`). Save a snippet to a temporary `.sh` file and run
>   `bash "<resource root>/bin/li-run" <file>`; it prepares `LINTEL_SOURCE_ROOT`, `LINTEL_REPO_ROOT`
>   and the profile context.
> - **Tools:** Read=`view`, Write=`create`, Edit=`edit`, Bash=`bash`/`powershell`, Grep=`grep`,
>   Glob=`glob`, AskUserQuestion=`ask_user`, TodoWrite=the plan checklist, Task or a named role=`task`
>   with that custom agent, WebFetch=`web_fetch`.
> - **Other Lintel workflows** are native skills: invoke `/li-<name>` rather than reading their
>   files. Named roles such as `CodeReviewer` are custom agents.
```

The agent preamble uses the same first two bullets (the agent file's directory is `.github/agents`,
so `{root}` is `../..` locally or `../lintel` vendored), plus one line: "You were delegated by a
Lintel workflow; stay inside the supplied task and report changed files, checks run, findings by
severity and limitations."

### Recorded payloads (Copilot CLI 1.0.89, probes 2026-09-28; sanitized)

The fixtures under `tests/fixtures/copilot-hooks/` reproduce these shapes exactly. `<SID>`, `<WS>`
and `<TP>` replace the session ID, workspace path and transcript path. Prompts are shortened.

```json
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790585052483,"cwd":"<WS>","source":"new","initialPrompt":"Step 1: ..."}
{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","session_id":"<SID>","timestamp":"2026-09-28T08:44:21.480Z","cwd":"<WS>","tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"echo HOOKPROBE-DENY-TEST","description":"Run HOOKPROBE-DENY-TEST echo command"}}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790585070626,"cwd":"<WS>","toolName":"powershell","toolArgs":{"command":"echo harmless","description":"Run harmless echo command"},"toolResult":{"resultType":"success","textResultForLlm":"harmless\n<shellId: 0 completed with exit code 0>"}}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790585078928,"cwd":"<WS>","transcriptPath":"<TP>","stopReason":"end_turn","stop_hook_active":false}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790585050419,"cwd":"<WS>","prompt":"Step 1: ...","transformedPrompt":"<current_datetime>...</current_datetime>\n\nStep 1: ..."}
```

The camelCase `preToolUse`/`postToolUse` shapes below were **recorded live** (probe 3, CLI 1.0.89,
`gpt-5-mini`, 2026-09-28) for the `create`, `edit` and `powershell` tools:

```json
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790593209613,"cwd":"<WS>","toolName":"create","toolArgs":{"path":"<WS>\\note.txt","file_text":"hello"}}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790593229281,"cwd":"<WS>","toolName":"edit","toolArgs":{"path":"<WS>\\note.txt","old_str":"hello","new_str":"hello world"}}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790593248561,"cwd":"<WS>","toolName":"powershell","toolArgs":{"command":"echo finished","description":"Run shell command to print finished"}}
{"sessionId":"<SID>","timestamp":1790593256140,"cwd":"<WS>","toolName":"powershell","toolArgs":{"command":"echo finished","description":"Run shell command to print finished"},"toolResult":{"resultType":"success","textResultForLlm":"finished\n<shellId: 0 completed with exit code 0>"}}
```

- **Contract-derived, not recorded:** camelCase `preToolUse` with `toolName: "bash"` (Linux, macOS
  and cloud). This Windows host has no Copilot Bash tool. The shape follows the documented contract,
  and is the `powershell` shape with a different `toolName`. Its live observation stays open and is
  recorded as `conditional` in the registry until a Unix Copilot host observes it.
- **Observed indirectly:** `userPromptTransformed` `transformedPrompt`. Probe 1's hook read it
  successfully, and the model saw the appended marker.

### Transforms

- **Invocation:** the regex `/li:([A-Za-z0-9<][A-Za-z0-9<>_-]*)` becomes `/li-\1`.
- **Tools:** the literal `AskUserQuestion` becomes `ask_user`.
- Nothing else in the body changes.
- **Links:** each span comes from `document_links`, and `target = local_link(canonical_rel, link)`.
  - An empty target (external link or anchor) is unchanged.
  - **Local mode:** `posixpath.relpath(target, generated_dir)`, and the target must exist.
  - **Vendored mode:** if `BUNDLE/target` is in the generated files, use the relative path.
    Otherwise use `https://github.com/jokerman89/lintel/{blob|tree}/main/<quoted target>`, keeping the
    fragment, following `bundle_documentation`.
- **Degradations recorded in docs:**
  - agents lose `memory`, `model`, `color`, `tier`, `voice`, `category` and `cli_support`;
  - skills lose `layer`, `color`, `tools`, `voice`, `cli_support`, `necessity`, `gap_if_skipped` and
    `navigation`.

### Hook registration mapping (from `hooks/hooks.json`)

The mapping below is authoritative. Matchers are exact, unescaped regular expressions over Copilot
runtime tool names. `write` is not a Copilot runtime tool: GitHub's reference maps `create` to
Claude's Write.

```text
SessionStart (any matcher)   -> sessionStart           matcher: (none)
PreToolUse   Bash            -> preToolUse             matcher: bash|powershell
PreToolUse   Edit|Write      -> preToolUse             matcher: edit|create|str_replace_editor|apply_patch
PostToolUse  Edit|Write      -> postToolUse            matcher: edit|create|str_replace_editor|apply_patch
Stop                         -> agentStop              matcher: (none)
UserPromptSubmit             -> userPromptTransformed  matcher: (none)
```

Anything else is a generation error. Each entry has `"type": "command"`, `bash`, `powershell`,
`timeoutSec` = the canonical `timeout` + 5, and `env: {"LINTEL_HOOK_ORIGIN": "plugin"|"repository"}`.
Repository entries add `"cwd": "."`.

### Launchers

- **`bash`:** `bash "<SCRIPT>" <event> <hook>... || true`, where `<SCRIPT>` is
  `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/adapters/copilot.sh` for the plugin, or
  `.github/lintel/hooks/adapters/copilot.sh` (vendored) or `hooks/adapters/copilot.sh` (local) for
  repository hooks.
- **`powershell`:** exactly the following, one line, with `<SCRIPT>` as above (PowerShell form
  `$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` for the plugin):

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue';$u=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false);[Console]::InputEncoding=$u;[Console]::OutputEncoding=$u;$OutputEncoding=$u;$c=@();$g=Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object -First 1;if($g){$d=Split-Path $g.Source;$c+=(Join-Path $d '..\bin\bash.exe');$c+=(Join-Path $d '..\..\bin\bash.exe')};$c+=(Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Git\bin\bash.exe');$b=$c|Where-Object{$_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_)}|Select-Object -First 1;if(-not $b){Write-Output '{"type":"progress","message":"Lintel hooks skipped: Git for Windows bash.exe not found"}';exit 0};$i=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd();$i|& $b "<SCRIPT>" <EVENT> <HOOKS>;exit 0
```

### Hook output contract (adapter → Copilot)

The adapter always exits 0. It prints optional progress lines (`{"type":"progress","message":...}`,
one line each), then exactly one final JSON object, or nothing.

| Event | Block (a hook exits 2) | Context or plain stdout | Non-blocking stderr |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preToolUse` | `{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":R,"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":R}}`; R = stderr of the first blocking hook (8 KB cap) | progress line per hook message | progress line |
| `sessionStart` | not applicable | `{"additionalContext":C,"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":C}}` | progress line |
| `postToolUse` | not applicable | `{"additionalContext":C,"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":C}}` | progress line |
| `userPromptTransformed` | never blocks | `{"modifiedTransformedPrompt": raw_tp + "\n\n<lintel-context>\n" + C + "\n</lintel-context>"}` with the skips in plan 2.3.b | ignored |
| `agentStop` | never blocks; no `decision` field ever | progress line + `{"systemMessage":C}` | progress line |

C is the escaped concatenation of all hook contexts in hook order, capped at 8 KB (4 KB for
`userPromptTransformed`). An exit code other than 0 or 2 is treated as non-blocking stderr.

### PowerShell dialect (`LINTEL_HOOK_SHELL=powershell|pwsh`, set from `toolName`)

- **Quoting:** `'...'` is literal, with `''` as an escaped quote. `"..."` takes backtick escapes, and
  a `$` inside it is an error ("shell expansion").
- **Escapes outside quotes:** a backtick escapes the next character, and backtick-newline is a line
  continuation. A backslash is a literal character.
- **Separators:** `;`, newline, `&&` and `||` are operators. A single `|` is an error.
- **Call operator:** a leading `&` followed by whitespace is peeled.
- **Errors:** `( ) { } < > @ #`.
- **Assignments:** `$env:NAME = <quoted or bare literal>` becomes an assignment word `NAME=value`.
  Assignment-only segments are allowed only for `LINTEL_OVERRIDE_*` names. `GIT_*`, `PATH`, `HOME`,
  `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `CDPATH` are rejected, and any other `$` is an error.
- **Git words:** `git`, `git.exe`, and paths ending in `/git`, `\git`, `/git.exe` or `\git.exe`.
- **Directory changes:** `cd`, `Set-Location` and `sl` with one argument behave like POSIX `cd`
  (a Windows path is accepted).
- **Overrides:** before running canonical hooks, the adapter parses leading
  `$env:LINTEL_OVERRIDE_SECRET`, `$env:LINTEL_OVERRIDE_CUSTOMER_DATA` and
  `$env:LINTEL_OVERRIDE_REASON` statements and exports their literal values.
- **POSIX branch:** byte-identical to the pre-change `_input.sh`.

### Manifests (bump together; a fresh collision check against `main` before merge)

- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (version)
- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (metadata.version and plugins[0].version)
- `.github/plugin/plugin.json` (version)
- `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` (metadata.version and plugins[0].version)
- `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` (version)
- `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` (version)

## Constraints

**Must respect:**
- ADR-0008: plugin hooks source only their own tree.
- ADR-0013: exit-2 semantics inside canonical hooks.
- ADR-0022/0023: Stop and prompt hooks never block.
- ADR-0024 (unsuperseded parts) and ADR-0028 (evidence separation).
- ADR-0035 (four families) and ADR-0037 (CI tiering).
- L-020, L-030, L-053, L-054, L-055, L-060, L-061.

**Must NOT:**
- edit canonical skill or agent bodies (only `cli_support` lines in P4);
- hand-edit generated files (the catalog, wiki and native kit);
- add third-party packages or require `jq`;
- enable repository hooks by default, or in Lintel itself in increment 1;
- capture environment values in evidence;
- amend, reset or rebase commits;
- push to `main` directly (merge through the PR only).

## Open questions

- VS Code Local's tool names and its acceptance of camelCase Copilot hook files. Recorded as
  conditional until observed; owner is increment 2 or a later observation.
- Whether cloud-agent `enabledPlugins` runs plugin hooks. Conditional; the kit's `--hooks` is the
  documented cloud route.
